title: Cron jobs
pausedCannotTrigger: Job is paused and cannot be triggered
activeCannotTrigger: A run is still active; inspect its run history before triggering again
deleteConfirmMessage: This deletes "{{name}}" and its run history, and cannot be undone. To stop it temporarily, click the status cell to pause instead.
runsLimited: The scheduler currently keeps only a summary of the most recent run
runsRetention: Each job persistently retains its 100 most recent outcomes
authorizeHint: When off, the job still runs on schedule but write and exec tools are denied.
authorizeStaleForm: The job changed after you confirmed the authorization, so this save will not authorize it. Review the content and tick the box again.
authStaleHint: The job changed after it was authorized, so the grant no longer applies.
deliveryPendingHint: Result saved; delivery will resume when the conversation is restored
restoreMessageHint: Your report is saved. Send the Weixin bot a message to restore the conversation; delivery will resume automatically without rerunning the job.
restoreLoginHint: Your report is saved. Sign in to Weixin again on the Channels page; delivery will resume automatically without rerunning the job.
draftSavedHint: Progress is saved, but this report is incomplete. Ask to continue in the original conversation.
archiveFailedHint: Archiving did not finish. The original artifact is retained; check the service logs.
reportDownloadFailed: Could not download the report. Refresh and try again.
automaticRecoveryHint: The report is saved. Delivery will retry after cooldown; there is no need to rerun the task.
localTimeHint: Uses your browser’s local time and saves a fixed instant.
fixedReminder: Send this reminder directly (no model generation)
attachmentPending: Attachment pending association; confirmation follows when received
attachmentMissingHint: The reminder text was sent, but attachments were incomplete. Check the linked originals.
keepAttachments: Attachments to keep with this reminder
unlinkAttachmentHint: Unchecking removes the link from this reminder; the saved original remains in the conversation. Request replacements in the original conversation.
attachmentBindingExpired: Attachment pending; auto-link window expired. Specify a file in the original conversation.
